brief:
Hamas denounced former German Chancellor Angela Merkel's statements on the war in Gaza, accusing her of providing political cover for Israeli violations and justifying attacks on civilian infrastructure, Shehab Wire reported.

The group alleged that Merkel's remarks served to shield Israel from accountability for what Hamas characterized as crimes during the conflict. Hamas did not specify which statements by Merkel prompted the condemnation.

title: Hamas condemns Merkel statements as cover for Israeli crimes
